description: This file defines an Android Activity class 'ReorderFour' that demonstrates reordering activities within an app, specifically starting 'ReorderTwo' with a reorder flag when a button is clicked.

classes.name: ReorderFour
classes.description: An Android Activity that sets a layout with a button which, when clicked, reorders the activity 'ReorderTwo' to the front of the activity stack.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and attaches a click listener to the button.

methods.name: mClickListener (OnClickListener)
methods.description: Defines the action to perform when the button is clicked: starting 'ReorderTwo' with specific flags.
